description: Improve hand appearance in generated model or lifestyle images.

fields.name: imageUrl
fields.description: Public URL of the image requiring hand repair. The image must be between 300 and 4096 pixels in both width and height, and its width-to-height ratio must be between 0.4 and 2.5.

fields.name: personType
fields.description: Person type. Supported values: 0 (girl), 1 (boy), 2 (adult woman), 3 (adult man).

fields.name: maskUrl
fields.description: Optional mask URL for the hand repair area.

fields.name: outputNum
fields.description: Number of images to generate, from 1 to 4. Defaults to 1.
